name: design-toolkit
description: Design-fidelity toolkit unifying two design-provider adapters: design-faithful (the claude-design / DesignSync provider) and figma-faithful (the figma / Figma-MCP provider). Ships each provider's translation + spec skills (design-faithful, design-faithful-spec, figma-faithful, figma-faithful-spec), an interactive fast-path for quick Figma iteration (figma-iterate), each provider's plan and fidelity reviewer agents, a spec reviewer for figma specs (figma-faithful-spec-reviewer; claude-design specs have none), the design-faithful on-request push of the repo's design system to a Claude Design project, and the library-conformance skill both fidelity reviewers load. The active provider is selected by config (the design-provider axis).
